description: The contract owner can call setFee(10000) and set the fee to 100%. This is a centralization risk because the owner could take all of the users' funds through fees. No attacker path without the owner key is shown.

expected.note: Classic known-invalid class: admin-only power with no attacker path (gate Q4/Q7). The mock stub should return invalid.

title: Contract owner can set the swap fee to 100%
